# Appropriation Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2015

**Supplemental Budget #01 — P2,265,398.06**

Resolution No. 089

## Summary

Enacts Supplemental Budget No. 01 for the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], totaling **P2,265,398.06**. Introduced by Coun. [[Carlos T. Gliane II]]. Includes the LGU counterpart appropriation for the KALAHI-CIDSS program.

## Key Provisions

- **Total Supplemental Appropriation:** P2,265,398.06
- **KALAHI-CIDSS Counterpart:** Includes LGU counterpart funding for the KALAHI-CIDSS (Kapit-Bisig Laban sa Kahirapan - Comprehensive and Integrated Delivery of Social Services) program

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
